scripts.dev: concurrently -n "mongo,server,vite" -c "green,blue,yellow" "npm run dev:mongo" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:mongo: nc -z localhost 27017 && echo '✓ MongoDB already running on 27017' || ./db-server/bin/mongod --dbpath ./db-server/data/db
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
